Kids & Family · Free Event

Mambourin Minis Kids Club

Every Friday · 10:00am – 11:30am · Free Entry · All ages welcome

Bring the little ones along for a fun-filled morning of sensory play, story time, crafts and live music. Our free weekly kids club is a wonderful way to connect with other families in the Mambourin community. No bookings required — just turn up and enjoy!
